description.value: Ding Hao Noodle House is a Taiwanese restaurant established in 2007 in Coquitlam, specializing in traditional beef noodle soup made with slow-cooked bone broth — no MSG or artificial concentrates. The owner/chef trained at Lao Shan Dong Homemade Noodle House in Taiwan, a restaurant recognized on the Michelin Bibendum Recommendation List. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down menu of Taiwanese classics — dumplings, braised beef rice, noodle soups, and an extensive bubble tea selection — in a spot conveniently located on Barnet Highway.

The site confirms the restaurant is an active, operating Taiwanese noodle house established in 2007, with a full menu, customer reviews, and current hours posted. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields are set to null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
